name: Pololu 5V 2.5A step-down regulator D24V22F5
description: Buck regulator from the battery to 5 V for the controller and 5 V sensors.
notes: Published: input 5.3-36 V (about 5.8 V needed at 2.5 A); 5 V out; 2.5 A typical max; 1 mA typical / 3 mA max quiescent; 17.8 x 17.8 x 8 mm; 2.3 g. Efficiency 94% at about 8 V in is read off Pololu's efficiency graph (between its 6 V and 12 V curves). The EN and PG pins are not modelled.
